verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's own docs list a first-party "Embeddings & Reranking" category with embedding and reranker models for search and RAG, alongside its LLM inference. A retrieval pipeline can therefore get embeddings and reranking from the same vendor. Missing for 10: API-level documentation of an embeddings endpoint and a rerank endpoint (request/response shape, OpenAI-compatibility for embeddings), named model catalog details, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can generate embeddings (and rerank results) for retrieval pipelines without a second vendor

citations.quote: State-of-the-art embedding and reranker models for search and RAG.
DeepInfra is an AI inference cloud that makes it simple to run the latest machine learning models at scale — LLMs, vision, embeddings, image generation, video generation, speech, and more.
